How baccarat works (Punto Banco)

Baccarat compares two hands — Player (閒) and Banker (莊). You wager on which hand will finish closer to 9, or on a Tie. Drawing is automatic and follows fixed rules; there are no player decisions after betting.

Card values & totals

  • Ace = 1 · 2–9 = face value · 10/J/Q/K = 0
  • Only the last digit counts: 7 + 8 = 15 → total 5
  • Best total is 9; totals range 0–9

Payouts (this demo)

  • Player win: 1 : 1
  • Banker win: 1 : 1 minus 5% commission (0.95 : 1)
  • Tie: 8 : 1 (demo rate; land casinos vary). On a tie, Player and Banker bets push.
  • 8-deck shoe, reshuffled when low. Virtual chips only.

Third-card rules (tableau)

Natural: if either hand totals 8 or 9 on the first two cards, both stand and the round settles immediately.

StageHand totalAction
Player0–5Draws a third card
Player6–7Stands
Banker (Player stood)0–5Draws
Banker (Player stood)6–7Stands
Banker0–2Always draws
Banker3Draws unless Player’s third card is 8
Banker4Draws if Player’s third card is 2–7
Banker5Draws if Player’s third card is 4–7
Banker6Draws if Player’s third card is 6–7
Banker7Stands

Note: the Banker decision depends on Player’s third-card value (not Player’s total) in the cases above.

Frequently asked questions

Is this real-money gambling?
No. Neon Ace Baccarat is a free entertainment demo with virtual chips only — no deposits, withdrawals, prizes or real-money wagering.
Why does Banker pay 0.95:1?
Banker wins slightly more often under standard rules, so casinos charge a 5% commission on Banker wins. This demo applies that commission to keep payouts realistic.
Can I make decisions during the hand?
No. Punto Banco is a comparing game: after you bet, the third-card tableau is applied automatically and the result is settled.
Is the result determined on my device?
For this static demo, the shoe is shuffled locally with the Web Crypto API. For any real-money, ranked or redeemable product, RNG, payouts and balances must be server-authoritative and signed; the client should only render verified outcomes.
Does it work on mobile and respect accessibility settings?
Yes. It is responsive, uses touch-sized controls, announces status via aria-live, keeps visible focus, and honors prefers-reduced-motion.
What data is stored?
Only your virtual bankroll, basic stats and sound preference in localStorage on this device. No account, cookies set by the game, or analytics.
